name: mcode-feishu-bridge
description: Drive MiniMax Code remotely from a Lark/Feishu conversation. A message you send in Feishu becomes a local mcode turn with full tool access, and the answer is written back into that same message in place, so a long task does not flood the chat. Requires the lark-cli and mcode CLIs the user already has; ships no credentials of its own.
